title: A* on an 8-Connected Occupancy Grid
hints: Index cells as id = r*cols + c. Keep g (best cost so far, init +inf) and parent arrays of size rows*cols.
Use std::priority_queue<std::pair<double,int>, std::vector<...>, std::greater<>> keyed on f = g + h. On pop, skip stale entries (a closed flag or f > g+h).
Octile heuristic: dx=|Δc|, dy=|Δr|, h = (max−min) + √2·min. It is admissible and consistent, so the first time you pop the goal its cost is optimal.
No corner cutting: for a diagonal move (dr,dc), require that both (r+dr, c) and (r, c+dc) are free. Reconstruct by following parent from the goal, then reverse.
